wikidot5e:spell:conjure-barrage.effectSummary: Using one nonmagical piece of ammunition or a nonmagical thrown weapon, create a 60-foot cone of duplicates. Each creature in the cone makes a Dexterity save, taking 3d8 damage on a failure or half on a success. The damage type matches the ammunition or weapon used as the component.

wikidot5e:spell:conjure-celestial.effectSummary: Summon a CR 4-or-lower celestial in a visible unoccupied space in range; it disappears at 0 HP or when the spell ends. It is friendly to you and your companions, rolls its own initiative, and obeys your verbal commands without using your action as long as they do not violate its alignment. Without commands it defends itself but otherwise takes no actions; the DM has its statistics. A 9th-level slot can instead summon a CR 5-or-lower celestial.

wikidot5e:spell:conjure-elemental.effectSummary: Choose a 10-foot cube of air, earth, fire, or water in range and summon an appropriate CR 5-or-lower elemental into an unoccupied space within 10 feet of that area. It disappears at 0 HP or when the spell ends. While you maintain concentration it is friendly, has its own initiative, and obeys verbal commands without requiring your action; without commands it defends itself but otherwise takes no actions. If concentration breaks, it remains for the rest of the 1-hour summoning period, becomes hostile to you and your companions, may attack, and cannot be dismissed by you. The DM supplies its statistics. Each slot level above 5th raises the maximum CR by 1.

wikidot5e:spell:conjure-fey.effectSummary: Summon either a CR 6-or-lower fey or a fey spirit in the form of a CR 6-or-lower beast into a visible unoccupied space in range. It disappears at 0 HP or when the spell ends. While you maintain concentration it is friendly, rolls its own initiative, and obeys verbal commands without using your action as long as they do not violate its alignment; without commands it defends itself but otherwise takes no actions. If concentration breaks, it stays for the rest of the 1-hour summoning period, becomes hostile to you and your companions, may attack, and cannot be dismissed by you. The DM supplies its statistics. Each slot level above 6th raises the maximum CR by 1.

wikidot5e:spell:conjure-hezrou.effectSummary: Summon a hezrou in a visible unoccupied space; it disappears at 0 HP or when the spell ends. At the start of each of its turns the DM secretly makes a Charisma check for you with a bonus equal to the consumed food's gp value divided by 20; the DC starts at 10 and rises by 2 each round. While the check succeeds, you can issue orders and it obeys. On the first failure, concentration is no longer required and you lose control; the hezrou prioritizes devouring visible corpses, or if none are available attacks the nearest creatures and eats what it kills. If reduced below half its hit-point maximum, it returns to the Abyss. During casting you may draw a protective circle around your space using the blood of an intelligent humanoid killed within the previous 24 hours; the hezrou cannot cross the circle or target anyone inside while the spell lasts.

wikidot5e:spell:conjure-knowbot.effectSummary: Touch one computerized device or system to create a knowbot bound to it for the duration. As a bonus action, direct the knowbot to perform a computer-related task that would normally require an action. Its Intelligence checks use your Intelligence score and proficiency bonuses, including hacking-tool proficiency when applicable. You have a limited telepathic link to it within 500 feet of the host system; if you leave that range it disappears after 2d4 rounds unless you re-enter range first, which immediately restores the bond. A slot of 5th level or higher extends the duration to 1 hour and the bond to 1,000 feet; outside that extended range the knowbot continues its last assigned task until the spell expires instead of disappearing.

wikidot5e:spell:conjure-lesser-demon.effectSummary: Summon up to eight total manes or dretches in visible unoccupied spaces; each disappears at 0 HP or when the spell ends. The demons are hostile to all creatures, share an initiative group, and attack the nearest nondemons as effectively as they can. During casting you may use the blood material to draw a protective circle around your space; this consumes the blood, and the summoned demons cannot cross the circle or target anyone inside it while the spell lasts. A 6th- or 7th-level slot summons sixteen demons; an 8th- or 9th-level slot summons thirty-two.

wikidot5e:spell:conjure-minor-elementals.effectSummary: Summon elementals into visible unoccupied spaces in range, choosing one CR 2-or-lower elemental, two CR 1-or-lower, four CR 1/2-or-lower, or eight CR 1/4-or-lower. Each disappears at 0 HP or when the spell ends. They are friendly to you and your companions, share an initiative group, and obey verbal commands without requiring your action; without commands they defend themselves but otherwise take no actions. The DM supplies their statistics. A 6th-level slot doubles the number summoned and an 8th-level slot triples it.

wikidot5e:spell:conjure-shadow-demon.effectSummary: Summon a shadow demon in a visible unoccupied space; it disappears at 0 HP or when the spell ends and has its own initiative. It obeys your orders while it can attack a creature on each turn and does not start its turn in bright light. If either condition fails, it immediately contests your Charisma with its Charisma; if you lose, concentration is no longer required and you lose control. The demon automatically wins this contest if more than 100 feet from you. During casting you may draw a protective circle around your space using blood from an intelligent humanoid killed within the previous 24 hours; the demon cannot cross the circle or target anyone inside while the spell lasts.

wikidot5e:spell:conjure-volley.effectSummary: Using one nonmagical piece of ammunition or a nonmagical thrown weapon, choose a point in range and create a volley filling a 40-foot-radius, 20-foot-high cylinder. Each creature in the cylinder makes a Dexterity save, taking 8d8 damage on a failure or half on a success. The damage type matches the ammunition or weapon used as the component.
